Change the constant to 24_000. Then check every test in tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py still describes real behaviour at that limit: a test that builds a packet to be 'over the default limit' must still be over 24_000 (grow its fixture, do not weaken its assertion), and the packet shaped like the measured case (added in the previous round) must still keep all beats and exits and at least 10 failing turns. tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-21
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -vE '^(factory/stations/fix_plan\.py|tests/test_factory_fix_plan\.py)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 tests/test_factory_fix_plan.py tests/test_factory_planner.py tests/test_factory_qualification_run_case.py
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "tests took $took s (budget 300 s)"
[ "$took" -le 300 ] || { echo "over the 300 s budget"; exit 1; }
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep '\.py$' || true)
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES
grep -Eq 'EVIDENCE_LIMIT_CHARS *(: *int)? *= *24_?000' factory/stations/fix_plan.py || { echo 'EVIDENCE_LIMIT_CHARS is not 24000'; exit 1; }
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/evidence-limit-24k.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/evidence-limit-24k.patch"
